about_the_game:
The streets are unforgiving.
Rogue Mafia challenges you to fight, loot, and survive in a world where rival gangs, armed thugs, From rain-slick back alleys to windblown industrial yards, every environment tests your skills, awareness, and nerves.

Your safehouse is your sanctuary — where you stash your hard-won loot, upgrade your arsenal, and prepare for the next raid. But once you hit the streets, it’s all or nothing: grab the goods, make it out alive, and build the respect you never had.


The city is calling. Will you make it out alive?

Every Zone, Every Threat

Each raid takes you into handcrafted urban and rural zones — streets littered with burned-out cars, abandoned banks, fenced-off container yards, overgrown forests, and gang-controlled hideouts. Some buildings you can breach, others remain locked, tempting you with the promise of loot inside.

Dynamic Weather 

Rain pours from the rooftops, wind howls through alleys, fog rolls in to cut visibility, or the sky clears to reveal every threat. The weather shifts without warning, forcing you to adapt your tactics on the fly.

Gear Up Like a Gangster

Loot explosives, guns, armor, and backpacks to carry your haul. Each run offers a chance to find rare weapons or vital supplies hidden in safes, vehicles, or guarded caches.

Smart Enemies

Face off against gangsters and armed criminals who flank, ambush, and hunt you with tactics that keep you on edge. They know the streets — and they know how to use them.

Your Safehouse, Your Advantage

Store your loot, upgrade your weapons, improve armor, and stockpile supplies for future runs. Every improvement increases your odds of making it out alive next time.

Risk vs Reward Survival

Go in heavy for maximum firepower… or go in light for speed and stealth. But remember — whatever you take into the streets can be lost forever if you don’t extract.

Rogue Mafia delivers the raw tension of survival, the thrill of a perfect escape, and the crushing weight of a bad decision.

The city is calling. Will you make it out alive?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS or equivalent (e.g., SteamOS 3.0)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Memory: [TBD] MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU with at least 500 MB of memory
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: [TBD] MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound chip or compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: - Compatible with most modern Linux distributions, including SteamOS (Steam Deck). - If you have a dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD), you should be fine. - 64-bit OS required for Unity builds.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 Sierra or later
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: [TBD] MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU with at least 500 MB of memory
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: [TBD] MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound chip
  • Additional Notes: - Compatible with both Intel-based and Apple Silicon Macs (e.g., M1/M2). - If you have a dedicated GPU (e.g., AMD or Intel Iris), you should be fine. - Requires macOS 10.12 or later for Unity compatibility; older versions may not support modern builds

short_description: The city never sleeps… but you might not wake up. Rogue Mafia throws you into a ruthless top-down extraction shooter where every bullet, deal, and heist earns you respect — or buries it. Outgun rival crews, claim turf, and rise to power in a world that respects only strength.
